text: The smart machines are all asleep in their charging docks.
What's left is iron, chalk, and a squat rack older than every app on my phone.
No strap on my wrist. No tin in my pocket. Nothing asking what I'm measuring.

choices.text: Pick a weight and move it. No goal past that.
Be honest with myself: everything else was making me feel behind.

text: An hour goes by and produces exactly zero data.
Breath, iron, one more rep. That's the whole math.
Tomorrow my legs are going to send the bill.
No score's going to soften it. No streak's going to explain it away. Fine.

choices.text: Let it cost what it costs.
I'll still check my recovery score on the way out. I know.

text: Last plate racked. I stretch by feel, not by timer.
The soreness will be the only proof this happened. That'll do.
